bottomSlot.en-US: Renders extra elements at the bottom.

children.zh-CN: 使用 usePopover 时的触发器，默认是一个显示当前颜色的色块按钮；不使用 usePopover 时不渲染。
children.en-US: The trigger when `usePopover`, a swatch of the current color by default; not rendered without `usePopover`.

className.zh-CN: picker 根元素的类名；使用 usePopover 时位于弹层内。
className.en-US: Class name of the picker root element; it is inside the popover when `usePopover`.

defaultFormat.zh-CN: 手动输入时默认使用的颜色格式，可选 `rgba`、`hex`、`hsva`。
defaultFormat.en-US: Color format used by default for manual input: `rgba`, `hex` or `hsva`.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控的初始值，是同时包含 hsva、hex、rgba 三种格式的 ColorValue 对象。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial value when uncontrolled, a ColorValue holding hsva, hex and rgba.

eyeDropper.zh-CN: 是否开启滴管拾色器，需要 HTTPS 或 localhost 等安全 context，且浏览器为 Chromium 95 以上，否则无效果。
eyeDropper.en-US: Whether to enable the eyedropper. It needs a secure context such as HTTPS or localhost and Chromium 95 or later; otherwise it has no effect.

height.zh-CN: 高度，单位为像素，未设置时为 280。
height.en-US: Height in pixels; 280 when not set.

onChange.zh-CN: 用户选中颜色时的回调，参数为 ColorValue，包含 hsva、hex、rgba 三种格式。
onChange.en-US: Called with a ColorValue, holding hsva, hex and rgba, when the user picks a color.

popoverProps.zh-CN: 放入 Popover 时传给 Popover 的属性，如 `trigger`、`aria-label`、`aria-labelledby`。弹层默认以点击触发、role 为 `dialog`，名称默认取语言包；`aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 优先。
popoverProps.en-US: Props passed to the Popover when usePopover is on, such as `trigger`, `aria-label` and `aria-labelledby`. The popup opens on click with role `dialog` by default and takes its name from the locale; `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` takes precedence.

ref.zh-CN: picker 根元素（`div`）的引用；使用 usePopover 时指向弹层内的 picker 元素。
ref.en-US: Reference to the picker root element (`div`); it is the picker inside the popover when `usePopover`.

style.zh-CN: picker 根元素的样式；使用 usePopover 时位于弹层内。
style.en-US: Style of the picker root element; it is inside the popover when `usePopover`.

topSlot.en-US: Renders extra elements at the top.

usePopover.zh-CN: 是否放入 Popover 渲染，触发器使用 `children`，默认 `false`。
usePopover.en-US: Whether to render inside a Popover; the trigger is `children`. Defaults to `false`.

value.zh-CN: 受控值，形态同 defaultValue。传 `undefined` 视为非受控，从受控变回 `undefined` 时显示回到 defaultValue；传 `null` 是受控的空值，显示 defaultValue 且只报告变化。ColorValue 按不可变值对待，更新时整体替换。
value.en-US: Controlled value, same shape as defaultValue. `undefined` means uncontrolled, and going back to `undefined` from a controlled value shows defaultValue again. `null` is a controlled empty value: it shows defaultValue and only reports changes. Treat ColorValue as immutable and replace it as a whole.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，单位为像素，未设置时为 280。
width.en-US: Width in pixels; 280 when not set.
